m.d: My things are things that belong to me.
m.e: Is this my book, or is it yours?

m.d: You use myself when you are the doer and the receiver of an action.
If you do something by yourself, you do it without any help or alone.
You use myself to emphasize that it is you and not somebody else.
m.e: I know a lot of people love coffee, but I myself don't really like it.

m.d: A mystery is a secret or hidden matter which can't be explained.
m.e: She never told me where the money was, and it remains a mystery to me even now.

m.d: A mystery is a story about a puzzling event: short for mystery story.
m.e: The police investigation has failed to solve the murder mystery.

m.d: If something is mysterious, it is something that cannot be explained or is puzzling.
A myth is a story about gods and great heroes.
m.e: There are many myths about the Norse god Thor.

m.d: A myth is a story that is not true.
A myth is something many people believe but that is not true.
m.e: It is only a myth that people use only 10% of their brains.

m.d: If something is mystical, it inspires a sense of spiritual mystery, awe, and fascination.
Mythology is the study of stories about gods. Such stories are called myths.
A mythology is all the myths from a certain religion.
A mythology is all the background stories from a fictional world.
m.e: Tolkien invented an complex mythology for Middle Earth.

m.d: Myrtle is a female given name.
Myrtle is an evergreen shrub or small tree of the genus Myrtus. It is native to southern Europe and north Africa.
Myrtle is a dark green shade that resembles the color of Myrtus leaves.
If something is done mysteriously, it is done in an unexplainable or puzzling way.
If something is mythical it is from a myth (a story about gods).
m.e: There are many mythical stories about the Norse god Thor.

m.d: If something is mythical it is not real or not true; that is, it is like something from a fictional story or old myth.
m.e: A dragon is a mythical animal.

m.d: If something is mythical or of mythical proportions it is very great or amazing.
m.e: His skill with the baseball bat was mythical.

m.d: Myron is a male given name.
A mystique is a mystery, a mysterious aura.
